capabilities: Browse folders as grids of file previews with layouts, sorting and filters
Tag, rate and comment on any file, including non-note files
Preview images, videos, PDFs, PSD and AI files in a full-screen viewer
Drag files onto canvases and manage folders in a colored, icon-bearing tree
Record generation passports for AI-generated files via agent commands
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states no network requests, telemetry, accounts or payment; metadata lives in a __buba-data folder that must not be deleted or renamed.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lists files by name without previews and offers no way to tag, rate or comment on non-note files like images, videos or PSDs.

relations.evidence: With the Style Settings plugin installed, its settings get a Buba section
Copy the folder skills/buba-obsidian into your agent's skills folder, for example ~/.claude/skills/

summary: Visual asset library that shows vault folders as grids of file previews with tags, ratings, comments, a viewer and drag-to-canvas.
